verdict.rationale: Railway documents unlimited separate environments and per-PR preview environments [railway-docs-11, railway-docs-12], plus private connections between services [railway-docs-4]. This implies some environment separation, but nothing in the pack says non-production environments are network-isolated from production services or explains how that boundary is enforced. Missing for 10: explicit per-environment private network isolation, documented controls blocking cross-environment access, separation of production credentials and variables, independent or hands-on corroboration.
